title: 第49章 好人不该一直倒霉

第49章 好人不该一直倒霉-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

“因为我知道，你能行。”

赵素梅转过头看着他，眼眶红红的，但嘴角微微翘着，“自从分家那天开始，你就一直在赢。

赢大哥、赢老三、赢刘老四、赢对面那个钱大勇。

我相信你做什么都能做成。”

林国强看着她，忽然笑了。

“你笑啥？”

“笑你把我吹得跟神仙似的。”

“我没吹。”赵素梅认真地说，“你就是能行。”

林国强摇了摇头，把碗里的面汤喝完，站起来。

“行了，别站着了，进去收拾收拾，早点关门，今天早点回去。”

“嗯。”

赵志军在店里已经把东西收拾得差不多了，锅碗瓢盆都洗了。

灶台擦了三遍，地拖了四遍，亮得能照见人影。

他正在把椅子一张一张地翻到桌上，准备扫地。

“志军，今天早点回去休息。”

“行，三姐夫，你说今天这事，会不会上报纸？”

“上不上报纸跟你有啥关系？”

“要是上了报纸，咱们店不就出名了？

出名了生意不就更好了？”

赵志军嘿嘿笑着，一脸向往。

林国强摇了摇头，懒得理他。

三个人锁了门，推着自行车往村里走。

天还没黑，夕阳把天边烧成了橘红色。

林国强骑车载着赵素梅，脑子里却回想今天发生的事。

他今天冲出去制服周红，一方面是因为他是个退伍兵，见不得有人当街行凶。

另一方面，他确实存了一点私心。

他想结交刘强，想帮他。

林国强上辈子听说过刘强的事迹。

他是个好人，是个好警察。

他在镇上当所长的时候，治安是最好的。

他走了以后，镇上就乱了。

小偷小摸没人管，打架斗殴没人问，谁有钱谁说了算。

王超家后来之所以敢那么嚣张，跟那个新来的所长脱不了干系。

一千块钱，就把美丽被家暴流产的事给摆平了。

如果刘强还在呢？

如果刘强还是所长呢？

王家还敢不敢那么肆无忌惮？

林美丽被打得断手流产的时候，王超还敢不敢只花一千块钱就了事？

这些问题，林国强没有答案。

"Because I know you can do it."

Zhao Sumei turned her head to look at him, her eyes were red, but the corners of her mouth were slightly raised, "You have been winning since the day we separated.

Win the eldest brother, win the third brother, win the fourth brother Liu, and win the Qian Dayong opposite.

I believe you can accomplish whatever you do."

Lin Guoqiang looked at her and suddenly smiled.

"What are you laughing at?"

"Laughing at you for making me look like a god."

"I'm not bragging." Zhao Sumei said seriously, "You can do it."

Lin Guoqiang shook his head, drank the noodle soup in the bowl, and stood up.

"Okay, stop standing around, go in and clean up, close the door early, and go back early today."

"Yeah."

Zhao Zhijun had almost packed everything in the store and washed all the pots and pans.

The stove was wiped three times and the floor mopped four times. It was so bright that people could be seen.

He was turning the chairs one by one onto the table and getting ready to sweep the floor.

"Zhijun, go back and rest early today."

"Okay, third brother-in-law, do you think today's matter will be published in the newspapers?"

"What does it have to do with you whether it's in the newspaper?"

“If it’s in the newspaper, won’t our store become famous?

Wouldn't business be better if you become famous?"

Zhao Zhijun chuckled with a look of yearning on his face.

Lin Guoqiang shook his head and was too lazy to pay attention to him.

The three people locked the door and pushed their bicycles towards the village.

It wasn't dark yet, and the setting sun burned the sky orange.

Lin Guoqiang was riding Zhao Sumei, but his mind was thinking about what happened today.

He rushed out to subdue Zhou Hong today, partly because he was a veteran and could not bear to see someone committing murder in the street.

On the other hand, he does have a little selfishness.

He wanted to make friends with Liu Qiang and help him.

Lin Guoqiang had heard about Liu Qiang's deeds in his previous life.

He is a good man and a good policeman.

When he was the director of the town, public security was the best.

After he left, the town was in chaos.

No one cares about petty thefts, no one cares about fights, and whoever has the money has the final say.

The reason why the Wang Chao family dared to be so arrogant later had to do with the new director.

For one thousand yuan, the matter of Meili's miscarriage due to domestic violence was settled.

What if Liu Qiang is still here?

What if Liu Qiang is still the director?

Do the Wang family dare to be so unscrupulous?

When Lin Meili was beaten so hard that her hand was broken off and she had a miscarriage, did Wang Chao still dare to spend just one thousand yuan to end the problem?

Lin Guoqiang has no answers to these questions.
